text.en: Hetal looks at a calendar on the wall and a clock in the kitchen. The calendar tells her the day and date, and the clock tells her the time. She learns that a week has seven days, a year has twelve months and her birthday comes round once each year. She also reads the time on a clock.

A week has seven days. They are Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday, and then the week starts again. A year has twelve months. The names of the months and their order stay the same every year. A calendar shows each month in rows of weeks. We can find the day for any date by looking at the row and column. In July 2024, Monday is the first day and Sundays fall on the 7th, 14th, 21st and 28th. Thursdays fall on the 4th, 11th, 18th and 25th. Three days after Monday 22 July is Thursday 25 July.
A year has 365 days. That is 52 full weeks and 1 extra day, so a year does not have 53 full weeks. Some months have 31 days, some have 30 and February has fewer than 30. The days of the week and the dates of festivals change from year to year. Some festivals such as Independence Day, Republic Day and Christmas fall on the same date every year, while many others change. Your birthday comes once every year on the same date.
A birth certificate tells us a person's name, date and place of birth and the names of the parents. Bincy's certificate says she was born on 02/05/2015. That is the second of May in the year 2015. On 2 May 2025 she will be 10 years old, and on 2 May 2030 she will be 15. Her eighth birthday was on 2 May 2023. The certificate was made on 18 May 2015, which is 16 days after her birth. Age puzzles use these facts. If Hetal is twice as old as her brother and also 10 years older than him, then her brother is 10 years old and Hetal is 20.
A clock has a short hour hand and a long minute hand. The hour hand tells the hour and the minute hand tells the minutes. When the minute hand points to 12 it is an o'clock time such as 7 o'clock. When the minute hand points to 3 it is quarter past, 15 minutes after the hour. When it points to 6 it is half past, 30 minutes after the hour. Hetal starts breakfast at 7:00 and finishes at 7:15, so breakfast takes 15 minutes. We find the time taken by seeing how far the minute hand moved. We can write time in numbers as 8:15, which is quarter past 8, and 8:30, which is half past 8.

problem.en: What day is 25 July 2024 if 22 July 2024 is a Monday?

text.en: From the 22nd to the 25th is 3 days.
Monday + 3 days: Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday.
So 25 July is a Thursday.

why.en: Check with the calendar of July 2024.

problem.en: How old will Bincy be on 2 May 2025 if she was born on 2 May 2015?

text.en: From 2015 to 2025 is 10 years.
The birthday has just come.

why.en: The date 2 May is the same.

text.en: She will be 10 years old.

problem.en: Hetal started breakfast at 7:00 and finished at 7:15. How long did she take?

text.en: The minute hand moved from 12 to 3.
From 12 to 3 is 15 minutes.
She took 15 minutes.

prompt.en: Explain how to read 8:30 on a clock.

points.en: A week has 7 days and a year has 12 months and 365 days.
A calendar helps us find days and dates and count the days between dates.
We find age by counting how many birthdays have passed.
The short hand is the hour hand and the long hand is the minute hand.
Quarter past is 15 minutes after the hour and half past is 30 minutes after.
